{{Quote|Matriarch! Flesh Raiders broke through our defenses. They did something to our crop fields!|Eseni|<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" />}}
During the [[Flesh Raider uprising]] on the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] world of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Hero of Tython|apprentice]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] was forced to '''defend''' [[Kalikori village]]'s agricultural fields from an attack by [[Flesh Raider]] saboteurs. In [[3643 BBY]], after a successful [[Raid on the Tythos Ridge shield generator|raid]] on a Flesh Raider [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] in the [[Tythos Ridge]] mountains, the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] returned to the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] settlement of Kalikori Village in search of news on Din, who was leading a strike force of Jedi in an [[Assault on the Flesh Raider command base|attack]] upon the [[Flesh Raider command base]]. Just as the Padawan arrived, however, a team of Flesh Raiders broke through the village's lines and planted [[Poison/Legends|toxin]] [[Toxin mine|mines]] in the Twi'leks' agricultural fields, poisoning their crops. At the request of the village's [[Matriarch/Legends|Matriarch]] [[Ranna Tao'Ven]], the Padawan braved the poisonous clouds using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and disabled the mines, defeating the saboteurs and ensuring the village's safety.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|I shut down the energy shield. Any word on Master Orgus' mission?''"<br />"''No. My mother&hellip;she found peace during your absence. I'm now Matriarch.|The Padawan and Ranna Tao'Ven|<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> near the end of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the native [[Flesh Raider]]s of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] homeworld of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] began attacking in greater numbers. The Order had recently discovered that the former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]], the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Bengel Morr]]&mdash;who had vanished during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] [[3653 BBY|ten years ago]]&mdash;was the mastermind behind the Flesh Raiders' invasion. Din's [[Hero of Tython|newest apprentice]] had been sent to [[Raid on the Tythos Ridge shield generator|disable]] a Flesh Raider [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] so that another team of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] could [[Assault on the Flesh Raider command base|attack]] the [[Flesh Raider command base]].<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" />

However, after disabling the generator, Din's Padawan was contacted by Bengel Morr, who warned the Jedi that he planned to destroy the Order. Worried about Morr's plans, the apprentice raced back to the village of [[Kalikori village|Kalikori]], looking for Master Din to warn him.<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" />

==The raid==
{{Quote|I've never heard of anything like this before.''"<br />"''If these machines can poison us, they can destroy our crops as well. Please, help us. Jedi are strong. You can resist the machines and destroy them.|Tao'Ven, begging the apprentice for help|<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" />}}
[[File:Toxin_mine.png|thumb|right|200px|Toxin mines]]
When the Padawan arrived back at the [[Matriarch/Legends|Matriarch's]] compound, the Jedi was greeted by [[Ranna Tao'Ven]]&mdash;her mother [[Sumari]] had [[Death/Legends|died]] while the Jedi was gone, making Tao'Ven the new leader of the [[Pilgrims]]. Before Tao'Ven could discuss Orgus's whereabouts, a villager named [[Eseni]] rushed in and began to warn them that Flesh Raiders had attacked again. The enemy had left [[toxin mine]]s in the village's crop fields, which had poisoned one of the scouts when they tried to approach.<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" />

Tao'Ven begged the apprentice to help, believing that [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] could protect the young Jedi long enough to stop the mines. The apprentice agreed and rushed to the fields, where the enemy had planted three [[Poison/Legends|toxin]] mines. Using the [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] known as [[breath control]] to stop most of the poisonous effects of the gas, the Padawan began to disable the mines. However, several Flesh Raiders had buried themselves in the ground and burst out to attack the Jedi in an attempt to stop the apprentice, but the apprentice defeated them and successfully saved the village's crops from further harm.<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I saw how you suffered out there. What you suffered out there. What you did was more than brave&mdash;it was heroic.|Ranna Tao'Ven|<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" />}}
Returning to the Matriarch's building, the apprentice was thanked by Tao'Ven for the help. After giving the Jedi a token of the village's thanks, she left to tell the village the good news. The apprentice, meanwhile, contacted Master Din via [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]] and learned of his success against the Flesh Raiders. When the Padawan informed Din of Morr's goal of destroying the Jedi so he could ultimately rebuild them and destroy the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], he was relieved to hear that his former apprentice was not a Sith himself. During the attack on the Flesh Raiders' command base, Din had found the locations of many other camps&mdash;too many camps for the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] to only send Jedi Masters. As a result, Din requested that his apprentice [[Raid on the Forsaken Den|take out]] the base located in the ruins of Kaleth, since the apprentice had [[Skirmish at the ancient shrine|already defeated]] some of the natives who had been based at that camp.<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" />

==Behind the scenes==
The skirmish in the Kalikori Village fields appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. The raid represents the events of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class story mission "The Face of the Enemy," where the player returns to the village in search of Orgus Din but is forced to stop a Flesh Raider attack on the village.<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" />
